jd.text:
Job Summary

At Hala, the main responsibility of Payment product manager is to Lead the end-to-end delivery of payment service products, overseeing development through implementation. The role focuses on coordinating multiple initiatives, partnering with internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring high-quality, on-time product releases that meet business and customer expectations.

Job Duties

Manage and coordinate the delivery of payment products across the full lifecycle, ensuring plans, milestones, and outcomes align with business objectives.
Own release planning activities, including resource coordination and readiness, to ensure smooth and predictable product releases.
Build and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams, and customers to support clear communication and effective collaboration.
Track delivery progress and provide regular reporting on timelines, quality, resources, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies).
Ensure delivery commitments are met within agreed schedules, proactively addressing delays or risks.
Create and maintain detailed delivery plans covering each stage of the product lifecycle, from initiation through rollout.
Define and monitor end-to-end delivery KPIs to assess performance, efficiency, and product quality.
Identify delivery risks early, manage cross-team dependencies, and implement mitigation strategies to minimise impact.
Analyse customer feedback and operational insights to drive continuous improvements in delivery processes and outcomes.

Requirements

2–4 years of relevant hands-on experience in product management.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Strong ownership, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Experience in fintech and payments is preferred.

jd.text:
Overview
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the development and growth of our SME financing products in Saudi Arabia. You will take ownership from customer discovery and product strategy through launch and ongoing improvement, working closely with local business teams and international technology teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment, analytical skills, and hands-on delivery experience with an understanding of lending and the needs of small businesses.

About Us
Skyro is an international fintech group building its presence in Saudi Arabia. We are developing Sharia-compliant financing solutions that help individuals and businesses access the funding they need. Our B2B business focuses on making credit simpler and more accessible for SMEs through technology and partnerships.

Purpose of the Role
The Senior Product Manager will shape and deliver SME financing products that address real customer needs and support sustainable business growth. You will own the product roadmap and customer experience, balancing commercial objectives, credit performance, regulatory requirements, and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
Product Development & Delivery
Lead products and features from initial concept through, development, testing, and launch.
Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
Coordinate across local and international teams, resolve blockers, and make practical decisions.
Product Performance & Economics
Establish product metrics and monitor conversion, usage, repeat borrowing, and customer retention.
Work with Finance and Risk to understand profitability, acquisition, servicing costs, and credit losses.
Use customer feedback, funnel analysis, and experiments to evaluate results after launch.
Investigate performance issues with relevant teams and turn findings into concrete product actions.
Customer Journey & Partnerships
Own and improve the journey: application, onboarding, disbursement, repayment, and repeat borrowing.
Identify friction, reduce unnecessary steps, improve communication through the lifecycle.
Risk, Compliance & Operations
Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Sharia specialists to incorporate applicable requirements into product design.
Align customer journeys with credit policies, fraud controls, and operational processes.
Product Strategy & Customer Discovery
Research with SME owners, suppliers, and partners to understand financing needs, business workflows, and barriers to accessing credit.
Define the product roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on customer value, business impact, and delivery effort.

Required Qualifications
5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of financial services or fintech products.
Experience launching and improving lending, SME banking, payments, or other complex financial products.
Ability to use data to assess product performance and make decisions.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to deliver in an evolving business environment.
Professional proficiency in English and the ability to work with international teams.

Nice to Have
Experience building products for Saudi Arabia or other GCC markets.
Knowledge of SME lending, trade finance, or embedded financing.
Arabic language proficiency.
Hands-on experience with product analytics tools.
